claims.text: Pipo Saude is a Brazilian digital health benefits company founded in 2019 and based in Sao Paulo.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude - Kaszek

claims.text: Its platform lets companies buy and manage health plans, dental plans, primary care and wellness in a single place, designed for HR teams and employees.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude | ONEVC Portfolio

claims.text: Pipo Saude raised a $4.6M seed round led by Monashees and Kaszek Ventures, with ONEVC also participating, announced in June 2020.
claims.source_title: Healthtech Pipo Saude raises $4.6M from Monashees, Kaszek, and ONEVC - LatamList

claims.text: Pipo operates as a digital brokerage that sells and manages healthcare benefits for companies, ranging from insurance to mental health.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude - Kaszek

claims.text: The company says it uses technology and data to fight poor service, bureaucracy and opaqueness in a Brazilian corporate health market it estimates at BRL 480B.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude | ONEVC Portfolio

claims.text: Pipo earns a recurring brokerage commission on insurance sales, reported at around 5 percent of the insurance value.
claims.source_title: Pipo compra corretora de saude da Convenia - Portal Fusoes e Aquisicoes

claims.text: In January 2023 Pipo made its first acquisition, buying HRTech Convenia's health benefits brokerage operation, which had more than 40 clients and 11,000 covered lives.
claims.source_title: Assessoramos o primeiro M&A da Pipo Saude, corretora digital de saude e beneficios corporativos - Souto Correa Advogados

claims.text: In July 2021 Pipo Saude raised a $20 million Series A led by Thrive Capital, with Atlantico, Monashees, Kaszek and OneVC participating.
claims.source_title: Joshua Kushner's Thrive Capital leads $20M investment in Brazilian healthcare startup Pipo Saude - TechCrunch

claims.text: In August 2024 Pipo Saude raised a third round of R$35 million to accelerate growth, with Enseada, Scale Up Ventures and FJ Labs joining existing investors Thrive Capital, Monashees and Kaszek.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude capta R$ 35 milhoes para acelerar crescimento - Revista Apolice

claims.text: The August 2024 round was announced as an extension of Pipo's Series A, after the company raised R$120 million in July 2021.
claims.source_title: Pipo Saude levanta mais R$ 35M em investimento - Insurtalks

claims.text: Saude Business reported the R$35 million third round in August 2024, when the company projected reaching 200,000 lives under management by the end of 2024.
